zh.title: Swarm Aero推Gamera無人機 航程逾9000海浬
zh.summary: Swarm Aero公開Gamera軍用無人機；航程逾9000海浬；首飛目標2027年底；鎖定五角大廈量產計畫
body: 美國加州新創公司Swarm Aero於2026年9月15日公布大型軍用無人機Gamera，宣稱其設計航程超過9,000海浬，且能以低於現有機種的成本執行長程彈藥投射任務。該公司表示，這款無人機已於馬里蘭州國家港舉行的空軍與太空軍協會「空中、太空與網路會議」上，展出實體尺寸模型。
Swarm Aero共同創辦人暨營收長Oliver Palmer向Breaking Defense表示，目標是在2027年底進行首飛。Gamera翼展達72英呎，採用雙機身設計，並設有七個外部掛載點，用以裝載武器或其他酬載。
Swarm Aero強調，Gamera採用相對簡單、不刻意匿蹤的設計，優先追求航程與成本效益。該公司正爭取參與美國五角大廈的「大量模組化航空器」計畫，並表示可望低於空軍每架1,000萬美元的目標價格，惟尚未公布正式售價。
執行長Peter P. Kalogiannis則向Breaking Defense表示，Gamera能在指定任務距離內搭載至少2,800磅酬載，並可依任務需求在酬載與航程間切換。Swarm官網標示最大航程逾9,000海釈，但未附帶該航程下的酬載量，公司也坦言此數據尚未經實際飛行驗證。
Gamera採用Honeywell TPE331渦輪螺旋槳引擎，Swarm於2026年6月宣布選用該引擎，並表示Honeywell已供應首批推進系統。2026年8月，該公司另宣布獲得空軍研究實驗室超過1,000萬美元的合約，用於發展複合材料製造技術。
Swarm Aero亦指出，Gamera可透過可互換酬載執行監偵、電子戰、通訊與武器投放等任務；公司另開發名為Legion的指揮管制軟體，宣稱可讓單一操作者同時管理數十架無人機。
Swarm的競爭者包括General Atomics Aeronautical According Systems，其於2026年9月10日公布Wildfire無人機，亦角逐相同計畫，宣稱可提供超過9,000海釈的渡航航程，並能攜載兩枚長程反艦飛彈或四枚聯合打擊飛彈。

en.title: Swarm Aero Unveils Gamera Drone, Targeting 9,000-nm Range at Lower Cost
en.summary: Swarm Aero unveils Gamera drone; over 9,000-nm range; first flight targeted for late 2027.
body: California-based Swarm Aero has unveiled Gamera, a large military drone designed to fly more than 9,000 nautical miles and deliver long-range weapons at a lower cost than existing aircraft, according to the company. A full-size model was displayed at the Air & Space Forces Association's Air, Space & Cyber Conference in National Harbor, Maryland.

Chief Revenue Officer Oliver Palmer told Breaking Defense that first flight of Gamera is targeted for late 2027. The aircraft features a 72-foot wingspan, two parallel fuselages, and seven external mounting points for weapons and other payloads.

Swarm has emphasized a relatively simple, non-stealthy design that prioritizes range and affordability. The company is offering Gamera for the Pentagon's Massed Modular Aircraft program, and stated it could beat the U.S. Air Force's target of $10 million per aircraft, though no firm selling price has been announced.

CEO Peter Kalogiannis told Breaking Defense that Gamera would meet the program's requirement to carry at least 2,800 pounds over the specified mission distance, and that the design would allow operators to trade payload for range.

Swerm lists Gamera's maximum range as more than 9,000 nautical miles on its website, but does not specify the payload associated with that figure, and the projected range has yet to be demonstrated in flight. The interchangeable payloads for Gamera could support missions such as surveillance, electronic warfare, communications, and weapons delivery.

Gamera will use a Honeywell TPE331 turboprop engine, a selection announced in June 2026. In August 2026, Swarm announced more than $10 million in Air Force Research Laboratory contracts for composite manufacturing techniques and aircraft parts production.

Competition includes General Atomics, which unveiled its Wildfire drone on September 10, 2026, proposing it for the same program. General Atomics says Wildfire would offer a ferry range exceeding 8,000 nautical miles and could carry two Long-Range Anti-Ship Missiles or four Joint Strike Missiles.
